## Moura Encantada (CR 6)

This lovely lass has a winsome beauty with delicate features and voluptuous curves. Her skin is pale green and her hair shimmers like spun silver and gold, with leaves caught in her tresses.  

**XP** 2,400  
NG Medium fey (aquatic, shapechanger)  
**Init** +4; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +12; **Aura** blinding beauty (30 ft., DC 21)  


**Defense**


**AC** 17, touch 14, flat-footed 13 (+4 Dex, +3 natural)  
**hp** 63 (9d6+9)  
**Fort** +6, **Ref** +10, **Will** +9  
**DR** 5/cold iron Weaknesses enchanted bond  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., swim 30 ft.  
**Melee** sickle +9 (1d6+4)  
**Ranged** longbow +10 (1d8/×3)  
**Special Attacks** charming glance  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 6th; concentration +10)  


Constant—speak with plants  

At will—entangle (DC 15), tree shape, wood shape (1 lb. only) (DC 16)  

3/day—charm person (DC 15), deep slumber (DC 17), tree stride  

1/day—suggestion (DC 17)  


**Druid Spells Prepared** (CL 7th, concentration +10)  


4th—summon nature’s ally IV  

3rd—call lightning (DC 16), cure moderate wounds, water breathing  

2nd—barkskin, flame blade, resist energy, tree shape  

1st—charm animal (DC 14), endure elements, entangle (DC 14), obscuring mist, produce flame  

0—detect magic, guidance, light, stabilize  



**Statistics**


**Str** 10, **Dex** 19, **Con** 13, **Int** 14, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 19  
**Base Atk** +4; **CMB** +8; **CMD** 18  
**Feats** Great Fortitude, Stealthy, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus (longbow), Weapon Focus (sickle)  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
**Skills** Bluff +15, Climb +9, Craft (sculpture) +9 (+15 when affecting wood, and +2 circumstance bonus from masterwork tools), Diplomacy +16, Escape Artist +18, Handle Animal +10, Knowledge (nature) +11, Linguistics +3, Perception +12, Sense Motive +7, Sleight of Hand +8, Stealth +15, Survival +8, Swim +12, Use Magic Device +8  
**Languages** Common, Elven, Sylvan; speak with plants  
**SQ** change shape (Small or Medium snake, beast shape I), tree meld, wild empathy +19, woodcraft  


**Special Abilities**



**Amphibious (Ex)** A moura encantada an survive indefinitely on land.  

**Blinding Beauty (Su)** Humanoids coming within 30 feet of a moura encantada and looking directly at her are blinded permanently (DC 21 Fort negates). A moura encantada can suppress or resume this ability as a free action. The save DC is Charisma-based.  

**Enchanted Bond (Su)** A moura encantada sickens and dies if she is forced to venture more than 1 mile from her bonded location or creature. She becomes sickened immediately and must make a DC 15 Fortitude save evey hour to avoid becoming nauseated for 1 hour. She takes 1d6 points of Constitution damage for every 24 hours she spends away from her enchanted bond until she dies. She can attune herself to a new location with a ritual taking 24 hours.  

**Spells (Su)** A moura encantada casts spells as a 7th-level druid, but she cannot swap out prepared spells to cast summon spells.  

**Dazing Glance (Su)** As a standard action, a moura encantada can overwhelm the thoughts and emotions of a creature she can see within 30 feet, causing the target to be dazed for 2d4 rounds (DC 21 Will negates). The save DC is Charisma-based.  

**Tree Meld (Su)** A moura encantada can meld her body into any tree large enough to contain her. This functions like meld into stone but has an unlimited duration.  

**Wild Empathy (Ex)** A moura encantada can influence the attitude of animals as the druid class feature, with a +6 racial bonus.  

**Woodcraft (Ex)** A moura encantada has a +6 competence bonus on Craft checks involving wood and is always treated as having masterwork tools for crafting wood.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** temperate forests  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or grove (3–8)  
**Treasure** standard (sickle, masterwork longbow with 20 arrows, other treasure)
